notes.title: New puzzles, Save system and Discount!
notes.content:
[h1]35% off during Puzzle Fest![/h1]

We are excited to announce a major patch for EF: Alchemist! We have been working on a while to fix issues and add some things you requested, as well as some things we had originally planned but couldn't make it in the release. Here's a list of changes:

[list]
[*] [h2]Extra puzzles and a new area![/h2] We had originally planned some extra stuff that was not ready during launch, but has now been refined and added to the game. This includes a new area and a couple of puzzles in key areas that lacked them.
[*] [h2]Save System![/h2] You can now save your progress at any time and load it later, with or without your friends. You can do so from the main menu. The game also auto-saves quite often, so that you never lose your progress!
[*] Other Quality of life fixes and improvements to performance.
[/list]

With that, Steam's Puzzle fest is about to begin, so be sure to check our entire catalog of games for great deals! As always, we'll be waiting for your feedback here and in our Discord server!

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: Alchemist is out!
notes.content:
[h1]The game is officially launched! [/h1]

Hello everyone,

After a lot of testing and a lot of work, we give you Escape First Alchemist!

Please keep in mind that we've had some trouble with some achievements and will be fixing them by tomorrow. Also, please note that translations to multiple languages are on the way and should be available in the next few days.

Other than that, have fun making potions and solving riddles and please leave us your feedback here or on our Discord server!

Thank you!
